messages.content: What's the population in New York right now?

function.name: time_converter
function.description: Converts the local time of user's region to the target region's local time. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

user_timezone.description: The timezone of the user in string format. Example: 'Pacific Time (US & Canada)'

target_timezone.description: The target timezone in string format where user wants to know the local time. Example: 'Eastern Time (US & Canada)'

time.description: The local time of user's timezone in string format (24 hr format). Optional parameter. Example: '15:30:00'

message.content: The most recent estimates put the population of New York City at roughly **8.8 million** residents. This figure is based on the latest U.S. Census Bureau estimates and includes all five boroughs—Manhattan, Brooklyn, Queens, the Bronx, and Staten Island. Keep in mind that the actual number fluctuates daily due to births, deaths, and migration, so the figure is an approximation rather than a precise count at this exact moment.

There's no function for population. So just answer. Provide approximate population of New York City. Also mention that population changes over time. Provide estimate.
